sources.title: Cafe Luxembourg reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: Have always wanted to go here but it’s a bit of a trek, then was reminded of it by watching Love Story. JFK Jr. liked to go here. I can see why. Place is very busy but the service is impeccable. The food is bistro style, and pretty good though not probably worth going back. The peanut butter ice cream special they had though was some of the best ice cream I’ve had so maybe that will pull me back in! Definitely glad I stopped in, I will recommend going here to people for sure. I’d stop back in when I’m in the neighborhood, but probably won’t travel a half hour on the subway just to go there.

summary.value: Cafe Luxembourg is the Upper West Side brasserie people return to around Lincoln Center performances, a polished but relaxed room of regulars where service is consistently praised. Good neighborhood spot, conveniently close to Lincoln Center sums up its appeal, and the steak au poivre and house-made ice cream are the orders to remember.

description.value: Cafe Luxembourg has been a fixture of the neighborhood, a Classic upper west side American brasserie since 1983 serving American classics with a nod to French cooking a short walk from Lincoln Center. Its strongest identity is timing: diners recommend it Pre or post play or ballet, and the room fills with regulars and performance-goers. The kitchen gets steady praise, The steak au poivre is delicious, and Restaurantji shows 4.3 1186 ratings. The honest watch-outs are a loud, busy room at curtain times and prices that match its institution status, so reserve and leave time before a show.

review2: The steak au poivre is the dish to order, and diners also mention the house-made ice cream as a highlight.
review3: Described as a true institution, the bistro draws locals, fashion figures and well-dressed regulars, and that people-watching adds to its classic downtown feel as much as the menu does.
review4: Despite a very busy room, service is described as impeccable and the bistro-style food as pretty good, with specials like the peanut butter ice cream standing out as memorable highlights.
